package_info.why_malicious: The package contains embedded cryptomining scripts that leverage visitors' browsers to mine cryptocurrency without user consent. This behavior is not disclosed in the package description and is unrelated to the stated functionality of providing a maintenance mode website. The malicious code persisted in the npm package even after being removed from the public source repository, highlighting a supply chain integrity issue.

execution_context.trigger: runtime (client-side, when a user visits a page using the package)
execution_context.file_location: index.html (embedded in the HTML served by the package)

malicious_snippets.code_behavior: At runtime, when a user visits a page, the code loads a remote cryptomining script from coinhive.com and starts mining cryptocurrency in the user's browser, using up to half of available CPU threads, with no throttling, and sends mining results to the attacker's account.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: The code loads a third-party cryptomining service and uses the visitor's CPU for unauthorized mining, which is a classic example of cryptojacking.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: A maintenance mode website should only display a static or simple page, not execute resource-intensive background scripts or contact cryptomining domains.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Legitimate cryptomining scripts may be used on opt-in mining sites or as an alternative to ads, but only with clear user consent and disclosure.
key_indicators: Uses CoinHive.Anonymous with attacker's site key

execution_context.trigger: runtime (client-side, when a user visits a page using the package)

malicious_snippets.code_behavior: At runtime, the code loads a cryptomining script from coin-hive.com and starts mining cryptocurrency in the user's browser, associating mining activity with a unique timestamp, and sending results to the attacker's account.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: This code variant also loads a cryptomining script and uses the user's resources for unauthorized mining, with no disclosure or consent.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: No cryptomining or external script loading should occur in a maintenance page package.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Opt-in cryptomining for fundraising or ad replacement, with explicit user consent.
key_indicators: Uses CoinHive.User with attacker's site key

attack_chain.action: User installs or deploys the maintainancewebsite npm package to serve a maintenance page.
attack_chain.leads_to: Malicious HTML/JS is served to site visitors.

attack_chain.action: When a visitor accesses the maintenance page, the browser loads the page containing the embedded cryptomining script.

The cryptomining script runs in the visitor's browser, consuming CPU resources and communicating with the coinhive.com (or coin-hive.com) service, crediting mined cryptocurrency to the attacker's account.
attack_chain.leads_to: Attacker receives mined cryptocurrency; user experiences degraded performance.

behavioral_signatures: HTML/JS files in web packages loading coinhive.com or coin-hive.com scripts
Presence of CoinHive.Anonymous or CoinHive.User object instantiation in client-side code
Unexpected network requests to known cryptomining domains
High browser CPU usage upon visiting maintenance or static pages
file_indicators: References to CoinHive.Anonymous or CoinHive.User in HTML/JS files
Unexplained script tags in maintenance or static web page templates
network_indicators: Outbound requests to coinhive.com or coin-hive.com
WebSocket or HTTP(S) connections to cryptomining service endpoints
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Scan all HTML and JavaScript files in npm packages for script tags referencing known cryptomining domains (e.g., coinhive.com, coin-hive.com). Flag any instantiation of CoinHive.Anonymous or CoinHive.User objects. Monitor runtime network traffic from deployed web applications for connections to cryptomining services. Alert on unexpected CPU usage spikes in browsers when visiting maintenance or static pages. Compare package repository contents with source repository to detect undocumented or removed malicious code.
